name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina Volkov's journey in motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the meticulous world of aerospace engineering. After graduating with honors from the Moscow Aviation Institute, she spent years ensuring the structural integrity of aircraft components. A chance visit to a local rally event sparked a passion that led her to transition her skills to motorsport, focusing on the demanding field of quality control.

Her approach is rooted in precision and a deep understanding of material science. Irina believes that rigorous testing and attention to detail are paramount to ensuring the safety and performance of racing components. She is known for her ability to identify potential weaknesses and propose innovative solutions, even if it means challenging conventional wisdom. Her colleagues appreciate her direct communication style and unwavering commitment to excellence.

What sets Irina apart is her relentless pursuit of perfection, combined with an ability to adapt her skills to the fast-paced and ever-changing environment of motorsport. She brings a unique blend of Soviet-era engineering rigor and a modern understanding of materials, making her an invaluable asset to RFK Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly bobbed and slightly wavy
physical.description: Irina is a woman of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting her practical approach to life.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of Russian coffee during late nights at the shop.
